_comment: Ad Hoc Session A3 -- built-in starter flag bundles for optimizer.py's --preset flag. Not a config format for user-saved presets (those live in the frontend's cloud-synced preset store, a separate mechanism) -- this file is the CLI's one-shot starting point for the three lineup types Greg builds: Cash, SE/3-Max GPP, and MME GPP (20-150 lineups). Any flag explicitly passed on the command line overrides the matching value here (see main()'s _load_preset_overrides()). lambda values are FLAGGED ARBITRARY -- see optimizer.py's --lambda help text and ROADMAP.md Ad Hoc Session A5; update once that backtest sweep validates real values.
